geometry_outcome: Modest source-feature improvement, insufficient as a meaningful ultrarealistic identity upgrade. Keep as an optional reversible shape, not an automatic production change.
structural_test: Passed neutral mesh checks: zero inverted skin triangles; topology and UVs preserved.
close_portrait_review: Inspected 740x720 native rendered crop. The small mouth/nasal/eye-spacing change is visible but the skin, eyelid-orbital anatomy and facial character remain synthetic and generic. No substantial identity or ultrarealism gain established.
blink_review: Inspected 740x720 full-blink crop at fit strength 1. Both lids close with no visible eyeball exposure and no obvious detached lash geometry. Lash direction still looks artificial; this does not approve combined motions or gaze.
limitations: Four generated stills are not a calibrated scan.
Small profile residual gain is below manual annotation uncertainty.
Landmark detection changes with shading; fine-ratio changes are not reliable by themselves.
No new true pore detail, scan anatomy, or skin material was added.
The original v4 profile fitting camera was too frontal; those coefficients were not refit in this camera-only correction. The old profile residual is not acceptance evidence.
application_test: Passed 0->1->1->0 idempotent toggle and exact packaged-delta reconstruction; no save or rig mutation.
recommendation: Keep the current production default and v4 inactive. The camera correction does not promote the shape. Front improvements and mixed fine-ratio changes remain; profile fit quality cannot be inferred from the original pose-mismatched comparison.
profile_assessment_correction: The earlier profile comparison was too frontal (57.6-degree yaw). Camera-only renders with unchanged captured baseline anatomy at 65, 71.4 and 75 degrees remove the excess far-eye exposure. Its prior attribution to anatomical failure is withdrawn. Nose/lip contour attribution from the old pose-mismatched panel is also not reliable.
